detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The wasteland is swarming with monsters so it's time to take on an impossible mission: get out. Command your drones, bolt weapons onto your cars, and keep the rails clear. The further you go, the harder the wasteland pushes back.

Juicy Bullet Heaven

Bloodthirsty hordes of enemies will do their best to stop your train, and it's your job to blow them into pieces. It's so satisfying, man.

Build Your Train

At every station, spend your coins on new cars, weapons, drone slots, and buffs. Reorder or merge cars together to make them stronger and unlock more module slots. The best train is the one you build on the fly.

Upgrade

Between runs, spend what you've earned on a permanent upgrade tree so every attempt starts a little stronger than the last.

Survive

…as long as you can. You're already doing well if you make it to Station 20. But the rails won't stop there. It's called Endless Rails for a reason. Keep going until you or the game crashes.

Features

  • Auto-firing drones that do the shooting

  • Short but action-heavy rides between stations (20-30 seconds)

  • New train cars, weapons, drone types, and buffs to mix and match

  • Merge train cars to make them stronger and unlock more module slots

  • A permanent upgrade tree

  • Juicy, satisfying combat built for short sessions and "just one more run" energy
